answer: The admission bond is time locked for 5 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are published in dawn, expire in relic, and ripple lists each expiry. Anyone running 198 aliases thus needs 180 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4329 identities would post 517 proofs and burn roughly 59 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
